info.title: Mimix API
info.description: Speech, voices and audio. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer mmx_…` (or `x-api-key`). Keys carry scopes; each operation lists the one it needs in `x-required-scope`. Long jobs return 202 and a job id; webhooks are signed with `Mimix-Signature: t=…,v1=HMAC-SHA256(secret, "t.body")`.
